findings.description: java.util.Random and Math.random are not cryptographically secure and must not be used for security decisions (e.g. tokens, passwords, salt).

findings.rule_name: Stack trace leaked in HTTP response
findings.message: Stack trace leaked in HTTP response
findings.description: Writing exception stack traces directly to the HTTP response leaks internal call-stack details to clients, aiding reconnaissance; Korean guidance forbids exposing internal error details.
findings.recommendation: Log the stack trace server-side and return a generic user-facing error; do not write printStackTrace output to the response.
